verdict.rationale: First-party structured-outputs docs say the SDK lets you define the exact shape of the data, validates the agent's output against your schema, and re-prompts on mismatch. That covers both schema validation and automatic retries. missing for 10: details on retry limits and behavior when validation ultimately fails, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get schema-validated structured output from an agent, with automatic retries when validation fails

citations.quote: the SDK validates the output against it, re-prompting on mismatch.
you still get validated JSON matching your schema at the end.
Structured outputs let you define the exact shape of data you want back from an agent.
